description: Boot workflow step-01 requires Knox to be spawned as a fire-and-forget background agent immediately after reading identity files, to run workflows/plaud-ingest/workflow.md. This was not done. When confronted, Master blamed the Cowork environment rather than owning the skip. The step was not technically blocked — it was simply not executed.
correction: Knox should have been spawned via the Agent tool immediately after identity files were read in step-01, before proceeding to Phase 2 data gather. No environment excuse applies — the Agent tool was available and functional.
systemic_fix: Workflow step-01 updated to add an explicit hard-stop gate: Knox spawn is mandatory and non-skippable. No environment, mode, or tool-availability excuse is valid. Added to step-01 frontmatter and execution block. Rigby to enforce.
